INSERT INTO fmsown.tb_scm_user ( user_id, user_clsf_cd, lgn_id, user_nm, emp_no, crt_user_id, crt_dt, updt_user_id, updt_dt ) VALUES ( #{userId}, COALESCE(#{userClsfCd}, 'PAR'), #{lgnId}, #{userNm}, #{empNo}, #{crtUserId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updtUserId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE fmsown.tb_scm_user SET user_nm = #{userNm}, emp_no = #{empNo}, updt_user_id = #{updtUserId}, updt_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE lgn_id = #{lgnId} AND user_clsf_cd = 'PAR'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fmsown.tb_scm_user_parco ( user_id, parco_user_id, user_pswd, user_orgnl_id, user_nm, emp_no, dept_cd, dept_nm, mbl_telno, user_contact_id, crt_user_id, crt_ot, updt_user_id, updt_ot ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{parcoUserId}, #{userPswd}, #{userOrgnlId}, #{userNm}, #{empNo}, #{deptCd}, #{deptNm}, #{mblTelno}, #{userContactId}, #{crtUserId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updtUserId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE fmsown.tb_scm_user_parco SET user_pswd = #{userPswd}, user_orgnl_id = #{userOrgnlId}, user_nm = #{userNm}, emp_no = #{empNo}, dept_cd = #{deptCd}, dept_nm = #{deptNm}, mbl_telno = #{mblTelno}, user_contact_id = #{userContactId}, updt_user_id = #{updtUserId}, updt_ot = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE parco_user_id = #{parcoUserId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fmsown.tb_user_contact ( seqid, email, mobilephone, created_at ) VALUES ( nextval('fmsown.tb_user_contact_seqid_seq'), CASE WHEN CAST(#{email} AS TEXT) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE fmsown.fn_encrypt(#{email}, #{encryptKey}) END, CASE WHEN CAST(#{mobilephone} AS TEXT) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE fmsown.fn_encrypt(#{mobilephone}, #{encryptKey}) END, DEFAULT ) RETURNING seqid
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN uc.email IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE fmsown.fn_decrypt(uc.email, #{encryptKey}) END AS email, CASE WHEN uc.mobilephone IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE fmsown.fn_decrypt(uc.mobilephone, #{encryptKey}) END AS mobilephone FROM fmsown.tb_scm_user u INNER JOIN fmsown.tb_scm_user_parco p ON u.user_id = p.user_id INNER JOIN fmsown.tb_user_contact uc ON p.user_contact_id = uc.seqid WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.user_clsf_cd = 'PAR' LIMIT 1
